contracts.transport: Manifest event + authenticated package pull; inline permitted for small tests
contracts.privacy: Academic content and provenance; no learner data
contracts.hard_invariants: Only APPROVED/CLEARED/READY/right-cleared items; changed versions never overwrite historical evidence; non-independent weight remains zero
contracts.receiver_action: Stage inactive, validate, persist immutable external version snapshots, activate only through governed ScoreMax admission transaction

contracts.hard_invariants: Released version only; effective dates and permitted inventory preserved
contracts.receiver_action: Store versioned blueprint and execute without changing academic rules

contracts.authority: ScoreMax delivery telemetry; advisory to academic governance
contracts.privacy: Question-version aggregates only; minimum-N suppression; no learner IDs
contracts.hard_invariants: Exact question version/checksum; LIVE-only; never auto-approve or rewrite questions
contracts.receiver_action: Store immutable evidence batch, surface exceptions/actions, retain academic human decision boundary

contracts.authority: ScoreMax inventory/mastery gap detection; Power House decides resolution
contracts.privacy: Aggregated inventory gap evidence; no learner-level data
contracts.hard_invariants: Request cannot create content identity, change readiness or set academic priority automatically
contracts.receiver_action: Link to existing Action Centre/coverage intelligence; acknowledge status

contracts.idempotency_key: event_id tied to immutable business transaction/state transition
contracts.privacy: Pseudonymous product/CRM IDs and commercially necessary facts only; no answer-level data or card data
contracts.hard_invariants: Duplicate delivery has zero duplicate side effects; refunds/reversals and one-level upstream teacher lineage preserved
contracts.receiver_action: Idempotent receipt, then update CRM/lifecycle/referral reporting projections once

contracts.privacy: Aggregated demand/CRM evidence references; no unrestricted personal data
contracts.hard_invariants: Cannot change answer, seed, mastery, approval, source or blueprint state
contracts.receiver_action: Store as advisory evidence and route to existing prioritisation/action workflow

contracts.hard_invariants: ACADEMICALLY_READY is not marketable live status; Growth must intersect with ScoreMax LIVE_TO_LEARNERS event
contracts.receiver_action: Update academic catalogue projection; market only when matching ScoreMax release/version/checksum is live
